content.value: An electromagnetic wave having amplitude of I V/m arrives at an angle of $3 0 ^ { \circ }$ to the normal in an air on a glass plate of index 1.60. The wave's electric field is entirely perpendicular to the plane of incidence. Determine the amplitude of the reflected wave.
